notes: Edge case — eGFR right at the boundary. NCT06942195 requires eGFR >=45 — exactly 45 is borderline (meets >= threshold, so technically qualifies). However, metformin is generally contraindicated at eGFR <45 per prescribing guidelines, so withholding it for 48 hours (as NCT06942195 requires) may be the intended path, but the eGFR of exactly 45 also triggers the exclusion criterion 'HbA1c <6% or >7.9%' check — HbA1c 7.2% is within range. The NCT06942195 exclusion states eGFR <45, so exactly 45 technically clears. But NCT05307731 creatinine criterion: eGFR 45 corresponds to creatinine approximately 133-140 µmol/L, right at/above the 133 µmol/L cutoff — borderline excluded. Marked false due to creatinine likely exceeding NCT05307731 cutoff and insufficient certainty across trials at this boundary eGFR.
